Initial release of AI Subtitle Adder — Auto-Generate and Burn In Subtitles.

- Supports adding subtitles in multiple languages, auto-sync, and batch editing for YouTube and social media content.
- Cloud-based processing using GPUs completes subtitle addition in 30–90 seconds per job.
- Simple setup: automatic token authentication and session management.
- Provides clear feedback for uploads, exports, credits/balance, and error handling.
